tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalogue by keyword. Returns matching products with id, name and price.

query.description: Keyword to search for, matched against product names

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the shopping cart by product id, with an optional quantity. Returns the cart total.

productId.description: Id of the product from search_products

quantity.description: How many to add; defaults to 1

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to the weekly newsletter and confirm the subscription.

frequency.description: How often to send the newsletter

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: List customer reviews for a product id, newest first. Returns rating and text for each review.

productId.description: Product id to list reviews for
